name: Today
document:
properties:
  note.tasknotes_manual_order:
    displayName: Manual order
    hidden: true
views:
  - type: tasknotesTaskList
    name: Today
    filters:
      and:
        - note["status"].isEmpty() == false
        - note["status"] != "done"
        - file.hasTag("archived") != true
        - or:
            - and:
                - note["scheduled"].isEmpty() == false
                - date(note["scheduled"]) <= today()
            - and:
                - note["scheduled"].isEmpty()
                - or:
                    - note["due"].isEmpty()
                    - date(note["due"]) <= today()
    order:
      - note["title"]
      - note["scheduled"]
      - note["due"]
      - note["projects"]
    sort:
      - property: note.tasknotes_manual_order
        direction: DESC
      - property: note["priority"]
        direction: ASC
      - property: note["title"]
        direction: ASC
    options:
      sections: day

name: Upcoming
document:
properties:

    displayName: Manual order

  - type: tasknotesCalendar
    name: Upcoming
    filters:
      and:
        - note["status"].isEmpty() == false
        - note["status"] != "done"
        - file.hasTag("archived") != true
